title: Read and Think: Understanding Stories
description: Read five short stories and answer questions about key details; explain why a character acts; match causes to effects; put a story in order; and retell a story in three parts.
learningFocus: Read a short story and use its details to answer questions, explain a character's actions, follow a cause-and-effect chain, order events, and retell the story.
adultGuidance: The stories are for reading, not just looking: your child reads the words and the pictures help. If stuck on a word, read the rest of the sentence, then come back to it. On Pages 2 and 5, ask why out loud before your child writes: the reason is always in the story. Page 1 is Nina and the red wagon (Saturday, her toys, Leo, the blue ball); Page 2 is Milo and the lost puppy (he takes it home because it is all alone, puts up a sign, and is glad); Page 3 is Ruby and her garden (hot sun, dry soil, water, tall plants, red flowers); Page 4 orders Oscar's tower (builds, big block, falls, rebuilds with a small block); Page 5 is Ivy and the red balloon (the wind blows it into a tree and Dad reaches it).

seo.title: Reading Comprehension Worksheets | Grade 1 Read and Think
seo.description: Five free Grade 1 reading comprehension worksheets with short stories about key details, character actions, cause and effect, sequencing, and retelling.
